id: title:charlesvien:keep the update banner when the feed s releasedate parses as a date

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop application release notes and update status handling; prevents YAML serialization errors and hidden update banners caused by unquoted timestamps or Date object mismatches.
review.reason: Adds a helper function `stringifyManifest` to serialize YAML while preserving quoted scalars, and replaces direct `yaml.stringify` usage with this helper. Also adds a normalization function to convert Date instances to ISO strings before rendering. This prevents downstream serialization failures and incorrect update status display in the Desktop app.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to the Desktop app's release notes and update status handling; no broader PostHog systemic risk or adoption metrics are demonstrated. The score is conservative as the change is localized maintenance and behavior correction rather than a broad capability or systemic improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper function stringifyManifest that serializes YAML using the yaml-1.1 schema, preserving quoted scalars.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop app release notes and manifest merging; prevents unquoted timestamps from becoming Date objects and breaking downstream string serialization.

observations.behavior: Replaces direct use of yaml.stringify with the new schema-aware stringifyManifest in release notes injection and manifest merging.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop update status handling; normalizes releaseDate to a string before passing to the renderer, avoiding hidden update banners caused by Date types.

observations.behavior: Adds a normalization function that converts Date instances to ISO strings and filters invalid dates, then uses it when emitting update info.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop update status handling; normalizes releaseDate to a string before passing to the renderer, avoiding hidden update banners caused by Date types.
